$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-spec-coherence.mjs (srs#560), each citing the live issue that removes it. Entry shape: {check, id | pair:[sourceId,targetId], issue, note}. The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the migration (#562 un-bakes headings, #563 wires the tree, #564 makes invariants leaves). Growing it needs an issue. `note` is for the human reader only; the key is check + id/pair.

entries.note: Composition (Part 6: Presentation) depends on Discovery. Discovery moved from Part 4: Structure to Part 7: Extensions under ruling R2 (the-greenman/srs#787, RFC-042 Change A) as part of unit P4 — Extensions is read after Presentation, so the edge is now forward. Pre-existing dependency, not introduced by the move; resolving it is an ordering/placement question for a later Wave 5 unit (P6 or a Part-order ruling), not this one.
Same edge as the no-forward-reference entry above: Composition (Part 6) now depends on Discovery (Part 7) after Discovery's R2 move to Extensions.
